text:
liam: hi folks, liam here ":wave:" starting in eng-platform today. running into onboarding friction: i sign into Okta -> Grafana/Datadog/Sentry redirect -> then a 403 "You are not authorized to access this application". who should i ask to get the proper entitlements?

rachel: welcome liam :tada: i'm on devex. paste your okta email and i'll open the grants (Datadog: read, Grafana: viewer, Sentry: member normally). also tell us if you need edit rights or pager access.

liam: liam.k@redwood.com. i only need view for dashboards now; might need edit later for a dashboard tweak.

identity-bot: identity-bot created ticket IDP-3510: "Entitlement mapping missing for liam.k@redwood.com (Grafana, Datadog, Sentry)". Assigned: rachel.

rachel: thanks. quick troubleshooting: try an incognito window to avoid stale SSO cookies. if same 403 then it's an entitlement mapping issue and identity must sync. i'll request Grafana invite and kick off Datadog team add.

tom: cc @rachel 12: if Datadog still shows 403 after team add, identity sometimes needs the 'okta email match' check (aliases cause problems). liam, confirm there isn't a gmail/google alias on your Okta profile.

liam: tried incognito, same error. Okta profile email is liam.k@redwood.com only.

infra-bot: infra-bot created INFRA-2921: "Grafana invite + Datadog team add for liam.k@redwood.com". Owner: tom. ETA: 8h.

rachel: sent request for Sentry membership; security approval required @security-bot. If you need crash-level alerts for a service, include the service name.

security-bot: security-bot recorded Sentry access request SENTRY-873. Security review queued; expected approval 24h. Reminder: Sentry requires 2FA on first login.

liam: got Grafana invite email and accepted. can view infra dashboards but cannot find "inference-costs" or "p95-by-model" in search.

rachel: some folders are restricted by ACL; if you can view most dashboards but cannot find a specific one it's probably folder ACL or search index. i've requested folder view access. if missing entirely, let me know dashboard name.

liam: dashboard names per onboarding doc: infra/inference-costs and infra/p95-by-model. i can see latency-overview but not cost or p95.

tom: granted folder ACL for infra to liam.k@redwood.com. reindex/search should update shortly. also created ticket INFRA-2922 to add you to Datadog team 'inference-observability' for inherited monitors/dashboards.

identity-bot: identity-bot: Datadog team add queued (IDP-3510 -> sync to Datadog). Expected completion: 3h.

liam: Datadog started working, i can view monitors and the cost dashboard now. thanks! small follow-up: how do i propose a tweak to the p95-by-model dashboard (reduce window to 7d)?

rachel: dashboard source is in the platform repo under infra/grafana/dashboards. Preferred workflow: open a PR with the JSON change or a Grafana patch, assign eng-platform reviewers. If it's a non-urgent UX tweak we do the PR route; if it's urgent for an ongoing incident, open a hotline with on-call.

liam: noted. also curious about alert routing: how do i get notifications to my PagerDuty for the model agent service?

rachel: to be paged you need to be added to the PagerDuty escalation policy for the relevant service. file a request in #people-ops-support with the service name and justification and we'll add you after a short runbook review. if you plan to be on rotation, schedule a runbook walkthrough with an oncall.

liam: last piece: Sentry invite still pending; security-bot said review queued. any way to expedite for debugging a first-week issue?

security-bot: security-bot: SENTRY-873 approved by security lead (approved for liam.k@redwood.com). Invite will be issued after identity sync. Reminder: enable 2FA before accepting.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Datadog membership sync completed for liam.k@redwood.com -> team: inference-observability. You should now see saved views and monitors.

liam: can confirm Datadog and Grafana now show the dashboards i need. Sentry invite arrived and accepted; 2FA enabled. everything is set. huge thanks for the quick turnaround! :raised_hands:

rachel: welcome aboard! adding a note to the new-hire checklist: expected timing - Grafana invites usually <1h, Datadog team sync 1-4h depending on identity, Sentry needs security review (~24h) unless expedited. ping #devex if you hit any other blockers.

liam: appreciated :heart:
